brand.zh: Learning Clustering · Module 09 · Rajaraman–Wong 延迟导向聚类
brand.en: Learning Clustering · Module 09 · Rajaraman–Wong delay-oriented clustering

why.zh: 从真实页面录下的操作演示：在链上切换跨簇的位置看延迟从 7 变成 10；在候选 DAG 上单步到 i 看 l1、l2，跳到结束看 8 簇、20 实例、输出 8，再把容量改成 3 看输出变成 11；然后在浏览器里写 evaluate_instance_delay()，快进其余四个函数，通过全部检查，并用自己的代码跑 6 个情形。
why.en: Recorded from the real page: moving the crossings on the chain to see the delay go from 7 to 10; stepping to i on the candidate DAG for l1 and l2, jumping to the end for 8 clusters, 20 instances and output 8, then setting the capacity to 3 to see the output become 11; then writing evaluate_instance_delay() in the browser, fast-forwarding the other four functions, passing every check and running six cases with your own code.
